verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a dedicated guide for bulk-launching workflows via its REST API (ironclad-docs-37), and an export-job API for pulling data out in bulk (ironclad-docs-7). Beyond that, the Records API is described only as retrieve/update/create with no batch semantics, and webhook creation explicitly requires separate requests per target URL (ironclad-docs-30). Bulk capability is therefore limited to specific operations rather than general multi-item actions. Missing for 10: bulk update/edit of records or contracts, general batch endpoints across item types, details on batch limits or behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
